title: 第25章 不服第26章 大好的头颅
lines: 翌日清晨。
高空之上，忽得又有三道身影疾速飞来。
他们便是赵泰的几位族人。
飞进皇宫直奔赵泰所待的地方，一年轻人落地后便立马道：“族兄，情况如何了？
嘿嘿，你是不知道，那些凡人军队作战，我让小蛤蟆释放了一些毒气，直接毒死几万人。”
说着，他右手手掌举起一只蛤蟆，左手还在剐蹭蛤蟆脑袋。
这是他豢养的小妖，仅仅相当于炼气中期的修为。
修真界底层玩物，毒蛤蟆。
它会释放一种毒气，措不及防之下修真者也会中招，除非随身携带解毒丸。
他路遇邑王跟汉王的军队争锋，于是便让毒蛤蟆施展毒烟。
这毒烟只是随风一飘洒落在交战军队当中，顿时便让这些凡人受尽折磨而亡。
如此手段，怎能不叫凡人惊惧。
神奇法术不会，但杀起凡人来绝对是手拿把掐。
赵家老祖便是考虑到这一层，于是才让这个喜欢玩宠物的族人跟着来。
好歹是二百多岁的老祖，他总是比这些年轻人更了解凡俗皇朝。
如此手段一用，必然没有凡人再敢造次。
赵泰将现在的情况讲出，几人听了都表示没问题，就这么办吧。
他也一样没什么主意。
一日后。
邑王大本营，他正在集结军队准备杀到京城去。
到底是古代，传递消息还是慢了些，等他的探子回来汇报京城不攻自破再到他召集军队，这中间浪费的时间可太多了。
军队前方，邑王高举一把宝剑呐喊道：“诸位！
赵家江山已经不攻自破，我等此时急行军去往京城，占领皇宫！”
“占领皇宫！”
声震苍穹，军队很有气势。
下一刻，一道闪光从邑王身上划过。
“啪嗒。”
大好的头颅掉在地上。
前排，所有士兵和将领纷纷惊得忍不住后退一步。
“占领皇宫！”
前排虽然安静，但后排看不清的还在哪儿喊。
“大王死了！”
一个士兵突然嚎叫一声。
别说士兵了，就连将领们都变得不知所措。
content_en:
The next morning.
High in the sky, three more figures suddenly flew towards them quickly.
They are several of Zhao Tai's tribesmen.
He flew into the palace and went straight to where Zhao Tai was staying. After landing, a young man immediately said: "Brother, how is the situation?
Hehe, you don’t know that when those mortal armies were fighting, I made the little toad release some poisonous gas, directly poisoning tens of thousands of people. "
As he spoke, he raised a toad in the palm of his right hand and was still scratching the toad's head with his left hand.
This is the little demon he raised, which is only equivalent to the cultivation level of the middle stage of Qi refining.
A toy at the bottom of the world of cultivation, a poisonous toad.
It will release a poisonous gas, and cultivators who are unprepared will also be infected unless they carry an antidote pill with them.
On the way, he met the king of Yi who was fighting with the army of the king of Han, so he asked the poisonous toad to use its poisonous smoke.
The poisonous smoke just drifted in the wind and fell among the fighting armies, causing these mortals to suffer torture and death immediately.
How could such a method not scare mortals?
Magical spells can't be used, but killing mortals is definitely easy.
The ancestor of the Zhao family considered this aspect, so he asked this tribesman who likes to play with pets to follow him.
After all, he is an ancestor who is more than 200 years old. He always understands the mortal dynasty better than these young people.
Once such a method is used, no mortal will dare to do it again.
Zhao Tai told the current situation, and several people listened and said that there was no problem, so let's do it.
He also had no idea.
One day later.
At the base camp of the King of Yi, he was gathering his troops and preparing to fight to the capital.
After all, it was ancient times, and the news was still a little slow to be delivered. Too much time was wasted between waiting for his spies to come back and report that the capital was defeated without attacking, and then for him to summon the army.
In front of the army, the king of Yi raised a sword and shouted: "Everyone!
The Zhao family is already in ruins. We are waiting for an urgent march to the capital and occupy the palace! "
"Occupy the palace!"
The sound shook the sky, and the army was very impressive.
The next moment, a flash of light flashed across King Yi.
"Crack."
The big head fell to the ground.
In the front row, all the soldiers and generals were so shocked that they couldn't help but take a step back.
"Occupy the palace!"
Although it was quiet in the front row, people in the back row couldn't see where they were shouting.
"The king is dead!"
One of the soldiers suddenly howled.
Not to mention the soldiers, even the generals were at a loss.
"Quiet~!"
